summary: Practise KPI analysis, evidence checks and executive recommendations. Explore senior management report writing training and enrol with TrainingCred.
lede: Senior management report writing turns performance, risk and resource evidence into concise reports for executive decisions. It is designed for reporting analysts, department heads and governance professionals, who practise checking sources, analysing KPI variance, escalating risk through COSO ERM, linking recommendations to accountable owners, and reviewing AI-assisted drafts.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who prepare, review or rely on reports for senior management decisions, resource allocation and risk oversight.
modules: KPI Variance and Balanced Scorecard Measures
COSO ERM Risk Reporting and Escalation
prerequisites: Working familiarity with departmental performance reports, KPI updates or management risk reporting is recommended. No coding or programming is required.
